# Anviora

> Software for Indian pack manufacturers to issue EU-scannable battery records: serials, QR, a public page, and an India certificate vault. Not a notified body, not CPCB, not the EU DPP Registry.

## Products

- [Battery](/battery): LMT, industrial >2 kWh, and EV passport records from 18 February 2027 (Art. 77). QR for all batteries (Art. 13). Certificate vault for papers you already have.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](/pricing): Prepaid passport credits. Ask about a 90-day pilot. DGFT TRACE is a separate testing/certification reimbursement scheme — not a discount on this software.
